narr: A line of severe thunderstorms moved through the area on the afternoon of May 4th. Damaging winds associated with the storms resulted in several trees blown down across Ashley and Chicot counties.
ev: Major flooding occurred in Dermott with two feet of water covering highways.
lsr: FLOODING DESCRIBED AS MAJOR WITH TWO FEET OF WATER COVERING HIGHWAYS AND BARRICADES GOING UP - REPORTED BY DERMOTT EM.
